## Normalised financials

Q2 2026 Adjusted EBITDA reached **$769M** (10.4% margin) on 197,325 retail units sold ($7,125 GPU). Cash balance stands at $2,630M.

1. Revenue growth is unit-driven, not price-driven.
2. GPU expansion carries most of the EBITDA improvement.

`net_leverage = (total_debt - cash) / ltm_adjusted_ebitda`

### Model workbook interface

EBITDA of $758M bridges to the $769M above through four identified add-backs (net $11M). Carrying debt of $5,790M against $2,630M of cash is net leverage of 1.2x on LTM Adjusted EBITDA of $2,576M.
